race.comment: TALK TOO MUCH (1) sat handy from the outset last start at Belmont when off a long break, fading to end up 2.6L off the winner. This is an easier race today and the slight drop back in trip may hold the key. The tongue tie goes on and he can land the knockout blow. CAVALLERIA (11) is a 5YO on debut for the Grantham stable and looks to have had her issues on the way through. Her latest trial was super however, with Pike on board there. An inside draw helps her chances and this looks a suitable race on debut. NORTHERN DIAMOND (5) was only 4.6L off the winner here last start when in the market. She was off a very long break this time in work and she should be starting to build now third-up into the campaign. A better run is on the cards. BAHNBOUGLE BABY (7) can run an improved race.
